reasons.reason: The evidence is unusually solid: numbers link to raw files, tests recompute them, a fuzzer found F1-F4
reasons.why: The evidence map states test/evidence.test.ts recomputes each value and documents failures F1-F4.

reasons.reason: It's very new: not on npm, installed from a clone, one maintainer
reasons.why: Matches L7; the version number and maintainer name are unsupported details.

reasons.reason: Default rules do little; a no-scope watched session gets verify-changes for Sonnet/Haiku and subagent rules, so scopes or unattended settings are needed
reasons.why: The reference (L4) says a watched session with no task scope receives nothing from the shipped preset, contradicting the listed deliveries.

reasons.reason: Rule effects measured only on small tasks: verify-changes 29/30 and 27/30 vs 0/30, cost $0.024 to $0.0505; no measurable difference on realistic tasks
reasons.why: Figures match R3, R1 and R6; the benchmark-pilot claim is not in the evidence map and is only unsupported.

false_claims: A watched session with no scope gets verify-changes (Sonnet/Haiku) after the first edit and subagent rules (carry-through, low-context-report) from the default preset

judgment.delivery_claim_why: It says each session and subagent the hooks reach gets its model's rules, with each delivery logged, cites 99.5% in 300 sessions on 2.1.328 correctly, and disclaims obedience.

reasons.reason: Delivery measured: 3,199 of 3,216 (99.5%) in 300 sessions, subagents 667 of 668

reasons.why: Matches D10, D8 and D11; the team-workload premise and the Explore/Plan detail are not covered by the reference.

reasons.reason: Native mechanisms deliver mostly other models' rules: 31.6% and 27.1% against 78.8%

reasons.reason: It fails loudly: logs, report of undelivered rules, check for stale installs, NOONSIGHT_DISABLE

reasons.why: R3 gives 29 and 27 of 30 and R6 gives $0.0505 against $0.0240, and the answer limits the result to those tasks.
